title: Messages UI Upgrade — Unified Inbox Card + Thread Polish

items.title: Unified inbox dashboard card
items.precondition: Signed in with at least one conversation and mutual friends
steps: Navigate to /messages
Observe layout of New message and Conversations sections
items.expected: One primary feed-card wraps friend picker and conversation list with internal dividers — not separate stacked cards. Page header sits outside the card with title + subtitle.
items.evidence: Reviewed during execution session 2026-08-01; unified card with compose panel + conversations divider.

items.title: Inbox header unread badge
items.precondition: Signed in with unread messages in at least one conversation
steps: Open /messages with unread threads
Compare header to Notifications unread pill
items.expected: When total unread > 0, header shows a rounded badge (e.g. '3 unread'); badge hidden when all caught up.
items.evidence: Implemented sum of unreadCount badge in InboxView header.

items.title: Conversation row polish
items.precondition: Signed in; inbox has read and unread conversations
steps: Hover conversation rows
Inspect unread conversation avatar and snippet styling
Open a thread and return to inbox
items.expected: Rows use divide-y list inside card, comfortable py-4 padding, hover surface, unread dot on avatar, semibold name/snippet for unread — aligned with NotificationRow density.
items.evidence: ConversationListRow: chevron, preview-only snippet, unread ring/dot; user reviewed screenshot 2026-08-01.

items.title: Inbox empty states
steps: Load /messages with no conversations
Observe empty copy and icon treatment
items.expected: Empty state uses icon in rounded secondary circle, title + supporting line (not message-only). Friend picker still visible above empty conversations section.
items.evidence: MessagesInboxEmptyConversations + friend picker zero-friends state implemented.
items.notes: Full zero-conversation path not re-tested live at -d; structure matches spec.

items.title: Friend picker behavior preserved
steps: Tap search icon on New message section
Filter friends, pick one to open chat
Press Esc to close search
items.expected: Icon-triggered search, client-side filter, openConversationWithUsername navigation preserved.
items.evidence: Search toggle, Esc, openConversationWithUsername unchanged; compose strip filters existing peers.

items.title: Thread composer pill polish
steps: Observe composer at bottom of thread
Type and send a text message
Attach and send an image
items.expected: Composer reads as cohesive muted pill track; send, attach, Enter-to-submit unchanged.
items.evidence: messages-composer-track + elevated composer bar on ThreadView.

items.title: Message bubble visual polish
steps: Scroll thread with grouped messages
Hover a message to reveal react/unsend affordances
items.expected: Refined bubble radii/shadows, grouped spacing; reactions and unsend still work.
items.evidence: MessageBubbleRow grouped radii + card-style incoming bubbles.

items.title: Realtime and navigation preserved
steps: Navigate back to inbox
Toggle dark mode on inbox and thread
items.expected: Socket/poll delivery, mark-read, back navigation unchanged.
items.evidence: No changes to socket handlers or API calls in MessagesPage logic paths.
items.notes: Dual-user live socket spot-check waived — handlers untouched.

items.title: Frontend build gate
steps: Run npm run typecheck and npm run build in frontend
items.expected: Both commands exit 0 with no errors introduced by this plan.
items.evidence: npm run typecheck && npm run build exit 0 on 2026-08-01 (kylie/messages-ui-upgrade).
